temporis

Translation status: ภาษาไทย reader-locale proof. Code fences render through the th-TH pipeline; prose is canonical Latin.

Sets a timeout-like duration for a test modifier.

Syntax: temporis <number>

Category#

testing

Related#

  • metior
  • repete

Examples#

radix/corpus/temporis/temporis.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Sets a timeout-like duration for a test modifier.

# =============================================================================
# temporis — Sets a timeout-like duration for a test modifier.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Test timeout — `temporis` sets a duration constraint on `proba` execution
#   • Test modifiers — combining timing with other test annotations
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • confusing temporis (test timeout modifier) with tempus (time type)
#
# See also: metior, repete
# =============================================================================



# temporis — timed test modifier
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   testModifier :← 'temporis' integer
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   No incipit — declaration or test-runner surface only.
#
# BACKEND:
#   declaration-only test modifier (whitelist: temporis/temporis.fab).
#

proba "timed case" temporis 5 {
    adfirma verum
}
